test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Have egg on your face

options.text: To be made to look foolish or embarrassed
Making a choice between two unpleasant choices

solution:
The correct answer is: **To be made to look foolish or embarrassed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Have egg on your face"** means to be made to look foolish or embarrassed. (मुंह पर अंडा होना - शर्मिंदगी महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He **had egg on his face** after boasting about his success, only to fail miserably.
 
 
 
• **"To be made to look foolish or embarrassed"** refers to a situation where someone is publicly shown to be wrong or ridiculed. (शर्मिंदा होना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was **made to look foolish** when she forgot her lines during the performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is **To be made to look foolish or embarrassed**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Defeat someone thoroughly** (किसी को पूरी तरह से हराना): To win a victory over someone in a very decisive manner.

 
 
• **Example:** The team defeated their rivals thoroughly in the final match.
 
 
 
• **Making a choice between two unpleasant choices** (दो अप्रिय विकल्पों के बीच चयन करना): Refers to a situation where one has to choose between two equally undesirable options.
 
 
• **Example:** He was caught between a rock and a hard place, having to choose between losing his job or moving to a distant city.
 
 
 
• **Reveal a secret** (एक रहस्य प्रकट करना): To make known something that was previously hidden or kept confidential.
 
 
• **Example:** She revealed a secret about her past that shocked everyone.
